lessons: THE EVIDENCE GATE VERIFIED REPEALED LAW. Nevo pages embed struck-through historical versions of every provision inside hidden elements (style display:none, <s>). --check-sources does a raw-text match, so a snippet copied from the struck pre-2017 Reg. 5ד(א) ('דירקטוריון תאגיד קטן רשאי להחליט') passed as 'verified against source' and propped up a REVERSED rule (reliefs called opt-in; since 2017 they apply by default with an opt-out disclosed on the first page). Read only the current visible text when sourcing from Nevo; the gate cannot tell you.

1.5.0 had REVERSED Reg. 7(a): it called the 3-days-from-auditor-signature limb 'not a deadline' and the 'whichever is earlier' reading 'backwards', while its own evidence snippet ended 'לפי המוקדם'. Self-consistency passed because the numbers matched; nobody read the snippet against the prose. Reg. 7(b) is about the periodic report's own signature date.

Expert caught three more real defects the drift brief never mentioned: Reg. 30(b) clock gave a full extra day for events learned before 09:30 on a trading day (same-day 13:00) and lacked the non-trading-day limb; the periodic report has FIVE chapters (Reg. 8(b)) with CEO/CFO certifications attached to the Part E ISOX report (Reg. 9ב(ד)); small-corp relief head (3) market-risk was deleted in 2017 and head (6) (9ג/11(1) exemption, 2022) was missing. Round 2 then found 9ג(ב)/(ג) carve-outs (banks, insurers, immaterial) missing, which made the skill's own bank example a false positive.

Small-corp threshold NIS 300M was stale since 1.1.2024 (ISA notice 31.12.2023: 335,519,486; band 279,599,572 / 391,439,401). Nevo prints the unindexed regulation text, so a Nevo-only check can never see it. Next indexation fires when CPI exceeds 10% over Dec 2023; re-check the ISA notices page each cycle.

Shelf prospectus 'valid up to 3 years' replaced with Sec. 23A(b)-(c): 24 months, ISA SHALL extend 12 on conditions, commercial paper 12 months; shelf offering report not needed where all terms were fixed in the prospectus (23A(f)).

Judge round 1 also caught: bank directives 'incorporate IFRS for some topics' was unsourced (BOI page says only 'adopt mainly US bank rules'); Sec. 267A(d) inverted ('up to three years' -> a policy over three years needs re-approval every three years); two evidence snippets quoted the wrong provision (superseded Reg. 30, Sec. 304 for Sec. 302).

lessons: The legal notice was the WRONG TEMPLATE for two cycles: a TIER_A_TAX tax-return disclaimer ('not a return prepared by a licensed representative', 'consult a tax adviser before filing or paying') sat on a securities-analysis skill that produces no return and organises nobody's tax figures. verify_legal.py passed it every cycle because the structural gate can only see that A notice exists, not that it is the right domain. Swapped to TIER_A_INVESTMENT with both statutory 3(b) limbs (the no-personal-interest disclosure was entirely absent), plus an accountancy limb. Legal subagent confirmed INVESTMENT is correct and TAX was wrong.

PROPAGATION FAILURE CAUGHT BY THE EXPERT, NOT BY ME: the '60 days' -> 'two months' quarterly correction landed in SKILL.md and SKILL_HE.md but NOT in references/hebrew-financial-terms.md (which also invented a 60-day half-yearly deadline) or references/domain-checklist.md. Phase 3f.1 requires grepping the WHOLE skill folder for every changed literal; I ran the fix before the sweep. Always sweep references/ and scripts/ for the OLD value.

The prior cycle's log claimed 'Verified quarterly deadline is exactly 60 days (תוך שישים ימים מסוף הרבעון, Reg. 39)'. That snippet does not exist anywhere in the regulation. Reg. 39(a) says 'בתוך חודשיים מיום הדוח' and carries a second limb (within 3 days of the auditor's signature on the interim review report) that the skill dropped entirely. A fabricated verification survived a full cycle inside the optimization log itself.

ICPAS 570 was cited to the לשימוע (for-comment) DRAFT PDF, not the issued standard, while 700 in the same evidence file was correctly cited to the issued 2024 revision. Repointed to the issued 'לוועד המרכזי' version.

Going-concern was stated as an absolute ('does NOT change the opinion grade'). The issued 570 shows that holds only where disclosure is ADEQUATE; where the going-concern disclosure is inadequate the auditor qualifies or gives an adverse opinion. Corrected. Note the Expert also claimed the paragraph sits under a dedicated heading after Basis for Opinion (revised-ISA structure) - the ISRAELI issued text says 'בסוף דוח רואה החשבון' (at the end), so I kept 'at the end'. Verified rather than transcribed.

Reg. 5ד(ב) has FIVE relief heads; the skill listed four, missing the associated-company Reg. 44 threshold doubling from 20% to 40%. Also the reliefs are OPT-IN under Reg. 5ד(א) ('כולה או חלקה לפי בחירתו'), not automatic, so 'expect those disclosures to be absent by right' was wrong for a corporation that never elected. Added Reg. 5ה entry/exit mechanics and the first-page disclosure requirement.
